reviews.review: Amazing game if you like military simulators
Fun to play with friends, but not so fun solo. Great war simulation!

Arma 2 is 10x better.


With Arma 2 it's way easier to jump into a scenario or create a mission and get a battle rolling.

With Arma 3, you get jerked around with BI's own invasive launcher with all kinds of crap spinning, flashing, twirling. 

I mean, just LOAD THE FRICKEN GAME. How hard is it?

On top of that, it has constant connection issues and makes just getting the game loaded take 5x longer than it should. "CONNECT TO UNIT" "CLICK HERE FOR DLC UPDATES" "CLICK HERE FOR"....FFS, I don't care about any of that crap. Load the game please.

What I call the "second PLAY button" has two options: play with mods, play without mods. 
Well, what if I decide to play without and later to play with? Go through all this annoying loading stages again? JEEEEZ....

Moving on, after the game finally loads (after watching BI "presents" Arma 3 disappear and reappear like 2 or 3 times), it loads. Then you're introduced to a bunch of unothordox menu choices. Wow, information overload.

In Arma 2, you have your Campaigns, Scenario missions, or the Editor.
Here you have simliar stuff but categorized very badly and with a lack of comprehensive information. How did it come to this?

It's like being in a maze of mirrors. They're really all just slight variations of each other and redundant.

Start the Campaign. Which campaign? Which sub-type of the campaign with which sub-settings?

Holy moly, I just want to play "the campaign". Why would I want to play all this other stuff, even *post campaign* campaigns. Really? 

What a screaming mess. Poorly presented. It's like they didn't even care and just threw a bunch of stuff up into confusing categories and left.

On to the Editor instead.

What in the wild world of horse manure is this?!

The editor is totally borked compared to the previous games. After button mashing and eyes bleeding from the information overload from what seems to be an intentionally redundant UI and confusing editor, I was able to toggle it back to the "classic" map mode. It's great to be able to place units down on the actual 3D but it's waaay more cumbersome. 

Just selecting units is a pain. Intead of selecting OPFOR->Men->Rifleman you have to figure out the Rubix cube thingy under the correct symbol, and mix and match, which still resorts in a drop-down menu to select the unit. It's like Romper Room. Match the different colors and shapes that associate with the correct side...or something...you want to select. 

It's like they used Common Core as an inspiration for the game's UI.

Holy batguana Batman! Also, there is no "Empty" category. Instead, an option to place a vehicle down "without crew" is buried at the bottom corner.  Lastly, placing the units down and setting the direction they are facing was super easy in Arma 2, just click in the circle. In Arma 3, there's extra effort involved, and simultanously pressing keys and mouse controls to rotate around. OOPS, you accidently selected the entire group, or the group. Better try again! Oops! Now you accidently raised them over the ground 10 feet. Better fix that. Oops! You didn't click it just right to select them and have to click a few more times to try again. Oops, you clicked and something else was selected, try again! 

Oh you want to set Waypoints? Gone is the "Waypoint mode" option for selected units. It's another song and dance. Ooops! You accidently toggled them into another mode. Oops! You accidently set a marker! Oops! You left clicked when you should have right clicked. Oops! the right-click drop down disappeared/glitched before you could left click your selection. Oops! Oops! OOOPS!

Going into game, the AI, even on the worst setting for accuracy, can headshot you from 1km away. Fortunately for Arma 2, the game actually registers your settings, so they can't do this when you set to where they can't. Also, there's a mod that makes it even more realistic so firefights realistically take longer and aren't some Unreal Tournament Instagib scthick.

Also, it appears the AI is a lot dumber than Arma 2. Enemy soldier pops out, sees me, then turns around and stands there waiting for me to shoot him in the back. Wow, totally dumb.

Graphics are much better than Arma 2, sound FX are good. But I'm gonna say the graphics ultimately suck because the point of the game is to have battles on large maps. Yet, the game engine feels like an updated Arma 2 engine, and can't handle rendering long distances. There's always the "magic fog" that appears to help with FPS. Or the grass/foilage/objects that gradually "spawn in" like you're playing a Bethesda game on a potato. I don't have a potato but even on max settings the game still does this and it looks tacky as heck. TACKY.
Can go play some other game like Just Cause with AIs all over and stuff exploding everywhere...nooooo probleeeem. I can appreciate they wanna make smart AI and dynamic battlespace possible but when the AI still sucks, terrain still renders like crap on max even on EMPTY maps, then maybe they should consider making a new engine or use someone else's? Just asking.

And then the load times are always long. Frustrating.
Then I hear all this issues with DLCs. Just get mods that don't require the DLCs. Sheesh.
Another note, they remapped the default keys from all their past games. Just re-map them yourself, however, you'll get random messages that the key you picked is already mapped to something. Go to find that something else...it doesn't exist. I went through all the drop-downs and couldn't find them anywhere. Instead, they let players double-click what's redded out as remapped-to already, AND THAT takes them to the conflicting function, and then you remap that. Only to find you picked a key conflicting with...a third function that you can't find in the menus either. WHAT IN THE ACTUAL F.... Wow. Is this game incomplete or something?

Funny thing is I remapped the 2nd conflicing function. Go back to the first, and now it says the key I'm trying to use is mapped A DIFFERENT function. "Raise turret". What? I'm in the Helicopter movement section. How can it affect "raise turrent" it said it confliced with "Countermeasures" only. When I fixed that, but now it says "Raise Turret". 

It's like the developers do not want you to remap anything and to screw with the player, they make it always produce a random "conflicts with" until you just give up remapping that ONE KEY. And does it really conflict? Yes. Because they said so. The fuctions in question are...HIDDEN. You just have to take their word for it.


This game tries to do a lot but doesn't do it very good. 
Overall, the game feels incomplete and it feels lazy.

The Campaigns suck. Linear go here, take a ride, listen to some boring voice acting about some boring crap. OMG. You can't skip the intro which they incorporated into the first campaign mission. JUST STFU and let me play the game. Maybe if it was a VR game going for immersion, that kinda thing would be tolerable. Otherwise...NOT!

I rate this:

ARMA 2 out of /10

EDIT: Flash-forward to 2023. Oh look, my RTX 3060 12gb 13th gen i7, 32GB ram gaming system runs this game as good as my old system from several years ago before they released updates that weirdly, oddly, made my old GTX970 and 16gb ram, i7 like 6 or 8th gen...run it like garbage. Nevermind, it ran great originally, the game was from 2013 and GTX660 wasn't the minimum but RECOMMENDED for it. So way above sys req THEN (I got this in 2018). NOW, sys is way more powerful (2023). In ARMA 2, on my OLD system, i can have massive, epic theatre-scale battles rendered with great FPS. In contrast, the "PoS" ARMA 3 struggles with 10 vs 10  battles ---this includes even with the NEW system. So all that huge landscape, research, and development...was all for naught. Total scam and greedy game. They should be fixing the issues but who knows what shenanigans they have going with hardware devs? It's sus. Anyways, meanwhile, the total failure of their ARMA 3 is now utterly COMPLETE.
